patch.objective: Apply policy engines for platform governance: Kyverno, OPA Gatekeeper and ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, policy as code and conformance reporting

sources.cite: CNCF Certified Cloud Native Platform Engineering Associate (CNPA) curriculum: Platform Engineering Core Fundamentals 36%, Platform Observability, Security and Conformance 20%, Continuous Delivery and Platform Engineering 16%, Platform APIs and Provisioning Infrastructure 12%, IDPs and Developer Experience 8%, Measuring your Platform 8%
sources.note: On 2026-11-17 the weights were confirmed through a third-party study page (kube-dojo.github.io/k8s/cnpa, summarizing fetch), which lists 'GitOps fundamentals' and continuous delivery in the core fundamentals domain and says to 'understand why GitOps uses pull-based reconciliation'. The official curriculum was not re-read; the objective wording is the course seed's.

sources.cite: Kyverno documentation (release 1.13), Policy Reports: Background Scans
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: background scans validate 'existing resources in the cluster that may have been created before a policy was created', for validate and verifyImages rules; they run periodically, by default every hour; violations go to a PolicyReport or ClusterPolicyReport; background scanning is on by default and spec.background: false turns it off; results are reported whether failureAction is Audit or Enforce, and a scan 'does not block any existing resources that match a rule, even in Enforce mode'. The validate rules page (release 1.18) could not be read on 2026-11-17 (the fetch was not approved in time): the admission denial's wording and the per-rule failureAction field are from memory of Kyverno's documentation (to verify).
